title: Denali Highway
direction: A mostly gravel road across interior Alaska from Paxson to Cantwell, past the Tangle Lakes. Services are very limited and the road is closed in winter.

sources.driveTimes: OSRM (router.project-osrm.org), OpenStreetMap data, computed at build time; excludes stops and traffic

stretches.title: To the Tangle Lakes
stretches.line: The eastern end, toward a chain of lakes.

stretches.title: Across the interior
stretches.line: The long gravel middle and west of the highway.
